title: Japanese Hangover Jambalaya Casserole
description: A Japanese-inspired take on the classic casserole, perfect for a hangover remedy.
instructions: Cook sushi rice according to package instructions.
In a large skillet, heat 1 tablespoon of oil over medium heat.
Add diced cheese and cook until melted, stirring occasionally.
Add Jamaican jerk seasoning and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Stir in cooked sushi rice, diced tomatoes, and furikake.
Transfer mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish.
In a separate bowl, whisk together eggs and a pinch of salt.
Pour egg mixture over rice mixture in the baking dish.
Bake for 25-30 minutes or until eggs are set.
Garnish with sliced green onions, if desired.
